description.text: Why SUT? 1. Situated in Shenyang—— a key modern city in the northeast;2. Engineering oriented comprehensive university;3. Pure English taught programs;4. Specifically international students' accommodation withcomplete facilities;5. Good climate with distinctively four seasons;6. Convenient shopping environment.Main Courses Project Charting, Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics,Mechanical Theory, Machinery Design, Electrical Technology Principle,Basic of Electronic Technology, Principle of Microcomputer andApplication, Engineering Material, Mechanism Manufacture TechnologyBasis, Electrical and Mechanical Drive and Control Technology, CNCTechnologyDuration Four yearsDegree Awarded Bachelor of EngineeringStudents who are eligible to obtain a bachelor's degree and undergraduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by Major Cultivation Program and pass the undergraduate dissertation.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Shenyang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport first page2. Passport empty visa page3. Notarized High school graduation certificate and the Chinese translation4. Notarized High school transcript and the Chinese translation5. English competence certificate6. Medical report7. Non-criminal record certificate8. Applicant who used to study or live in China needs to provide other documents based on the actual situation9. Two inch front bareheaded half length photo

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above.2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
